# True Path Digital

> True Path Digital helps owner-operated local service businesses find and fix the gaps between their marketing visibility, customer trust, lead response systems, and booked work.

## About

True Path Digital is a consulting practice based in Missoula, Montana, founded by Trevor Riggs. Its primary focus is owner-operated local service businesses — trade contractors, HVAC companies, plumbers, electricians, roofers, custom builders, auto repair shops, and similar field-service operators.

The business does not sell generic marketing retainers. It diagnoses specific problems in a company's marketing, website, Google visibility, and lead handling — then provides focused implementation to fix them.

## Services

### [Google Business Profile Optimization](https://www.truepathdigital.com/services/google-profile)

I help local service businesses clean up, strengthen, and better manage their Google Business Profiles so they appear in Google Maps results and convert more local searches into phone calls.

### [Website Design and Conversion Repair](https://www.truepathdigital.com/services/website-builds)

I build and repair websites for local service businesses that turn more visitors into calls, estimates, and booked work. No templates. No filler pages. Every page exists to solve a real business problem.

### [Lead Response and Follow-Up Systems](https://www.truepathdigital.com/services/lead-response)

I help local service businesses build simple lead response and follow-up systems so inquiries are acknowledged, tracked, assigned, and followed up — without adding unnecessary software or administrative work.

## Diagnostic Service

### The Under the Hood Audit ($750)

A structured diagnostic review of a service business's website, Google Business Profile, online reputation, local search visibility, and lead response process. The audit identifies where the business is losing potential customers and provides prioritized, actionable recommendations.

## Case Studies

Real examples of demand leak repairs and business results:

- [Benchmark Automotive Service](https://www.truepathdigital.com/work#benchmark-automotive-service): a new auto repair business that now receives calls from Google and its website every day.
- [Accurate Auto Repair](https://www.truepathdigital.com/work#accurate-auto-repair): corrected nearly 20 years of inconsistent online information and generated 30% more calls.
- [United Formulas](https://www.truepathdigital.com/work#united-formulas): proof that the same diagnostic approach also works outside the trades; the e-commerce rebuild produced an approximately 200% increase in customer retention.
